about.description: pEAK is the tokenized share class of the Peakwater Volatility Alpha Fund, a Singapore VCC sub-fund managed by MAS-licensed Pilgrim Partners Asia that runs systematic long/short cross-asset volatility strategies (including IBIT-, COIN- and MSTR-linked derivatives) targeting ~20% annualized absolute returns. It is issued and distributed on Ethereum through the regulated DigiFT exchange to accredited and institutional investors.
about.registryInfo: Peakwater Volatility Alpha Fund, registered sub-fund T24VC0084D-SF004 of Pilgrim Investment VCC (Singapore VCC Act); manager Pilgrim Partners Asia (MAS CMS licence, est. 2009, >US$1B AUM); tokenized and distributed by DigiFT (MAS-licensed exchange). Monthly subscription series (pEAK0726/pEAK0826/pEAK0926 as of Sep 2026) are listed as separate rows because each carries its own NAV; they convert into this master token at the quarterly roll-up (series burned, pEAK minted at the NAV ratio; last roll-up 2026-07-16). Sibling fund pEAK.BTC is listed separately as pEAK.BTC1025. DigiFT SubRedManagement contract balance (pending subscriptions/redemptions) excluded.
